description: Update admin panel compatibility and add notification configuration management. Ensure broadcast still works, add ability to view/edit notification config (grouping windows, push cooldowns) from admin panel, and update notification stats.
steps: Step 1: Update backend/src/modules/admin/admin.controller.js - Update broadcastNotification() if needed (it delegates to notificationService.broadcastNotification which was already updated in FEAT-002). Add a new controller getNotificationConfig() that reads AppConfig key 'notification_config' and returns current values merged with defaults. Add updateNotificationConfig() that validates and updates the AppConfig entry.

Step 2: Add new admin routes in backend/src/modules/admin/admin.routes.js: GET /notifications/config -> controller.getNotificationConfig, PUT /notifications/config -> controller.updateNotificationConfig. These sit alongside the existing /notifications/broadcast and /notifications/history routes.

Step 3: Update admin/src/pages/PushNotifications.tsx - Add a new section 'Notification Configuration' below the existing broadcast form. Display current config values (grouping windows in hours, push cooldowns in minutes for readability). Allow editing with a save button. Fields: Like Grouping Window (hours), Follow Grouping Window (hours), Save Grouping Window (hours), Like Push Cooldown (minutes), Follow Push Cooldown (minutes), Save Push Cooldown (minutes). Convert between display units (hours/minutes) and storage units (milliseconds) on save/load. Keep all existing functionality (broadcast form, history table, push stats) exactly as-is.

Step 4: Update the admin push stats endpoint (getPushStats in admin.controller.js) to also return notification group stats: total groups, unread groups across all users, groups created in last 24h. This gives admins visibility into the new system's behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can still broadcast notifications (existing flow unchanged)
Admin can view current notification configuration values
Admin can update grouping windows and push cooldowns from the panel
Updated config values are persisted to AppConfig and take effect on next notification creation
Broadcast history table still displays correctly
Push stats section shows additional group-level metrics
node --check passes for all modified backend files
TypeScript compiles for admin panel changes
findings: All backend files pass node --check. Admin TypeScript compiles with zero errors (tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck). Named import conflict between getNotificationConfig (from notificationConfig.js) and the controller export was resolved by aliasing the import to loadNotificationConfig. Push cooldown validation allows zero (for AdminBroadcast type) while grouping windows require strictly positive values.
